summary: The filed probe returned a decisive receipt and this turn interprets it and corrects the parent account. CheckRun 5d829fd30b3649f8bb9ef79e6bb3d624 resolved all four comparisons with complete witnesses: the heartbeat control left follower 2's reported leader at 1 (index 59), the up-to-date candidate's pre-vote under that live lease produced no response at all (index 60), and then the peer-form MsgForgetLeader with From=3, To=2 and Term=2 — a real voter and a well-formed term, so no field illegal — was accepted with an empty step error and moved the reported leader from 1 to 0 (index 61), after which the identical pre-vote that the lease had just withheld was granted (index 62). The answer to the boundary question is therefore no: the acceptance is not an artefact of the unset term, and every earlier receipt used the weaker message form. Mechanism, from source: Step's term switch matches only zero, higher and lower terms, so an equal non-zero term passes it untouched, and MsgForgetLeader has no case in the type switch either, so control reaches the default dispatch into stepFollower, which clears r.lead without reading the term. What changed in the records: (1) a new interpretation for the child question @legal_term_inbound, conclusion violated, defect_claim asserted, citing indices 59-62; (2) the parent interpretation (ce33f7b508af4244883ac9c81a2a4696-question-0) was corrected where its rationale said the acceptance worked because the wire form carries no term field and Step treats it as a local message — that causal clause now states that the term fails to gate the message at all, cites the new receipt for it, records index 46 alongside 45, and no longer implies the finding needs an illegal field; a joint-history note explains why a receipt from a separate producer experiment (the child's) is admissible evidence for the parent; (3) two knowledge entries, one fact capturing the well-formed delivery and one behavior capturing the term-switch fall-through into stepFollower. No new experiment was filed: remaining run budget is under one turn, and leaving an uninterpreted execution would be worse than closing this question cleanly.
